subject.title: fix(status): LINE /status intermittent no-response — fallback, timeout, and retry hardening

question: Should the 10-second status-render deadline apply to every shared status caller, or only to the LINE delivery path that motivated this PR?
rationale: The modified helper serves directive, native-slash, info-command, inline-action, and plugin SDK paths, so the deadline changes cross-surface product behavior rather than only repairing LINE delivery.

options.title: Limit timeout to LINE
options.body: Keep shared status rendering deadline-free and apply a fallback deadline only in the LINE-owned delivery path.

options.title: Approve shared timeout
options.body: Retain the repository-wide deadline after fixing the topology and disclosure defects and proving representative shared callers.

recommendation.title: Limit timeout to LINE
recommendation.body: Keep shared status rendering deadline-free and apply a fallback deadline only in the LINE-owned delivery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows dominant ownership and a major refactor of the shared auto-reply and status path.
